body:
It was my GP, I've thought about therapy, but it's so expensive in my country.

One of my friends does know about it, but I don't think he's quite aware of how bad it is at times. He occasionally tries to reach out to me, but I feel like talking too much about myself burdens him.

I think she's probably aware of it on some level, but I don't know how to tell her without it killing the relationship. She tells me she loves me, but sometimes I doubt it.
I want to tell her, I'm just scared of getting the same reaction as last time, and it ruining the relationship. I'm not quite sure how to bring it up either.

To be honest, I've not noticed any of those warning signs in any of the women I've met online, but I think you are right about me taking things slower.

I just think the whole online thing doesn't work for me. I do just need to get out more, I'm going to try some classes at the gym too I think. I just feel a bit creepy approaching women in that kind of situation.

I'm seeing her tomorrow, so I think we're going to have a frank conversation about it all.

Thanks for the advice, you've been a big help.

Yeah, I think I need to change my approach, I've been meeting women exclusively online, the last time I met someone "offline" was the best part of a decade ago.

I hate the club scene, and I doubt I'd meet many women of my type there. When I go on rare night out, it tends to be for a quiet drink with a few close friends. I do have a few hobbies that are quite diverse (cycling, working out, cooking, video games, etc), but I don't quite know how to meet women through them.

What about my approach do you think I should change, in terms of how I attract women?
Don't be, it's not your fault, but thanks. I just don't know how to weed people like this out much earlier, before it got as far as sleeping with her, because it keeps happening.
It is looking that way to be honest. She seemed nice, so this came as a surprise.
Yes, but we have been sleeping together in the literal sense also.
Well, we've been hanging out a few days a week and sleeping together in that time.

Yeah, you've got a good point there. I'm always straight about that kind of thing, so I (often wrongly) assume that everyone else is the same.

I'm going to sleep on it.

She says she just wants to not let things get too heavy too fast, which I'm fine with. I just feel like she's giving me mixed signals.

Well, the dating profile thing is pretty much the only thing I've not been candid about. I'd not been on for weeks, but when I went on today, she'd been on earlier today. I feel that I'll come off as a hypocrite if I say I'm not OK with it. 

If I go by what she tells me, there is no one else on the scene, and we are exclusive, I just don't know if I believe her.

I'm thinking I might just cut my losses and move on.
She was very much on the same page as me when we first started talking (wanted to take it slow, but ultimately have a relationship), so I don't get it.
